blocks.text: Sentences and their English: Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR). Words, meanings and how each word is built: the English Wiktionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.why: **окончательный** — оконча́тельный: final, ultimate; definitive; (grammar) inflectional. Wiktionary: оконча́ть + -тельный.
exercises.context: The English says which word it is.

exercises.q: Could you write me a letter of recommendation?
exercises.context: The English says which word it is.

exercises.why: **внима́тельный** — attentive, observant, observing, mindful, watchful. Source: Russian Wiktionary, «-тельн», meaning 1 (https://ru.wiktionary.org/wiki/-тельн).
**внимателен** — внима́тельный: attentive, observant, observing, mindful, watchful. Wiktionary: внима́ть + -тельный.
exercises.context: The English says which word it is.

exercises.q: This girl's hair had the red hue of the setting sun.
exercises.ru: Волосы у этой девушки имели ___ оттенок заходящего солнца.
exercises.context: The English says which word it is.

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: очарова́тельный — charming, enchanting, adorable, lovely, fascinating; оконча́тельный — final, ultimate; definitive; рекоменда́тельный — recommendatory; внима́тельный — attentive, observant, observing, mindful, watchful.
